author: MangoSmoothie_
body:
I think a really good feature would be if staff messaged players who have reported someone to tell them that they are looking at the accused player. This would prevent spam on /report.

What do you think?

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
What I do is just /msg the player who reported someone, telling them that I am spectating the one that they reported.

However, I do not believe that all staff do this, so I like this suggestion.

replies.author: Pavlo
replies.body:
yeah, some moderators do this, some don't...
It's really good to know that the mods have noticed your report. one time I sent in a report because some guy was flying, and asked a mod to spectate them. The mod didn't respond about my report or my request :/
